source: Two git archive HEAD snapshots of the sealed commits, extracted into new sibling directories.
archiveLineEndings: git -c core.autocrlf=false -c core.eol=lf archive preserves the committed LF bytes regardless of the host Git configuration. No runtime source normalization is performed.
generatedLayout: Fresh checkout, package-manager store, npm configuration and npm cache directories are created under ignored .local/T27-private-builds-v2/<report-id> from the start. Only immutable source archives, install logs, protocol, receipts and results remain in reports. No HOME or CODEX_HOME reassignment.
install: Declared pnpm@11.25.0: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile with a fresh isolated store. Neither repo has package-lock.json; npm ci would invent a different dependency protocol.
environment: Whitelist OS/runtime paths. Original USERPROFILE/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA are inherited only when present; HOME and CODEX_HOME are omitted, never reassigned. Task-specific empty npm user/global configuration and explicit pnpm store/npm cache isolate package configuration and generated dependencies. No inherited secret environment, .env file, node_modules/junction, or local database. The original Windows user profile remains accessible; this is not whole-profile sandbox isolation.
smoke: Copied platform and copied source start from fresh runtime state. Ordinary scoped HTTP map/policy/inventory/vehicle queries, independently reviewed shipment and actual positive physical receipt; model complete always throws.
limits: Node dependency installation and local source/platform startup only. Python/ASR binaries, optional media models and Chromium are separate declared host dependencies.
No fresh HOME or isolated user-profile claim; original OS profile paths and incidental OS-level caches are not replaced. The package store, npm config/cache and checkout are new task directories.
Not GCP deployment, not a provider quality test, not a full-size restore benchmark. Existing backup/process-crash artifacts remain separate.
note: No world starts during preparation. All failures retained and never counted as complete.
